% Beamer source: [b] pins the frame content to the bottom of the slide. Correct
% Beamer, and it survives conversion untouched and looking right. ltx-talk's frame
% takes a KEY-VALUE list, so a bare word is not an option at all: the whole list is
% discarded. No error, no warning, right page count, byte-identical pdftotext -- the
% content simply moves to the middle of the slide (C-FRAME-OPT).
%
% The discard is silent only while nothing in the list carries an '='. [b,label=x]
% raises "The key 'talk/frame/b' is unknown" and stops the build.
\documentclass{beamer}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[b]
\frametitle{Pinned to the bottom}
This paragraph sits at the foot of the slide, under the empty space.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
